title: Gigging in New Jersey and Long Island clubs; Philadelphia
summary: McRae played weekend shows in small white clubs and the Dew Drop, but rarely worked in Philadelphia, where people knew his brothers.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
